system.description:
You take a relaxed stance drawing your weapon back and preparing for a full force attack. You spend your turn preparing this attack until the beginning of your next turn. You cannot take a bonus action or reaction after using this jutsu.

At the start of your next turn, you Fire with full force. All creatures in a line 5 feet wide and 100 feet long originating from you must make a Dexterity saving throw at disadvantage, taking [Weapons damage] + 6d10 damage of your weapon’s type.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above A-Rank increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the damage by 2d10.
